params.1273: Escort the wounded man to Xenia in the graveyard south of Lumbridge church.
params.1274: First, you must rescue the man from his goblin attacker if you have not already done so.
params.1275: Talk to the man and agree to escort him south.
params.1276: Lead him south and enter the Lumbridge graveyard (check the compass in the top-right of the screen if you need to find south).
params.1277: Talk to Xenia and let her deal with the man.
params.1278: If you and your escortee get separated, you can find him back at the crossroads.
